scenarios.name: run-and-refine-command
scenarios.description: User runs a test command, reads the failure, asks to fix the failing test, reruns — full edit-run loop

turns.speak: run cargo test and tell me if anything fails
show me the full output of just the failing tests
the describe_items test is expecting '2 regular muffin' but the function now outputs '2 regular muffins' — fix the test to expect the plural
run just the describe_items tests to confirm

scenarios.name: compose-pipeline-iteratively
scenarios.description: User builds up a shell pipeline step by step, inspecting output at each stage to refine

turns.speak: find all rust source files that mention the word transcribe
now count how many matches there are per file
sort them by file name and show me just the file names and counts, no other output
perfect, now do the same thing but only for files modified in the last week

scenarios.name: git-commit-workflow
scenarios.description: Full git workflow by voice: check status, view diffs, stage selectively, write descriptive commit, verify log

turns.speak: what's the git status of the project right now
show me the diff for just agent.rs
that looks correct, stage agent.rs and the new routing_market test file
commit with message: add word-boundary matching to IntentRouter with punctuation stripping and market replay tests
show me the last commit to confirm it looks right

scenarios.name: build-fix-iterate
scenarios.description: User triggers build, gets errors, fixes them, rebuilds — the inner dev loop via voice

turns.speak: build the entire project and tell me if it succeeds
show me only the first compilation error, not the warnings
open that file at the error line and suggest a fix
apply your suggested fix and rebuild
great, now run the full test suite

scenarios.name: process-diagnostic
scenarios.description: User investigates system state: running processes, resource usage, then drills into specifics

turns.speak: show me all running processes that are consuming more than one percent of CPU
focus on rust processes, show me their memory usage and how long they've been running
is there anything consuming more than a gigabyte of memory
kill the oldest rt-voice-server process if it's been running more than an hour

scenarios.name: environment-audit
scenarios.description: User audits the dev environment — toolchain, paths, versions — then fixes a missing dependency

turns.speak: what rust toolchain am I using and where is cargo installed
check if wasm-pack and wasm32 target are installed
the wasm32 target is missing, install it
verify the wasm32 target is now available

scenarios.name: log-investigation
scenarios.description: User investigates application logs — searches, filters, correlates timestamps, finds root cause

turns.speak: show me the last fifty lines of the server log
filter for lines that contain error or warn, case insensitive
for each error line, show me the five lines before and after to get context
what's the most frequent error message and how many times does it appear
search the codebase for where that error is logged and show me the surrounding function

scenarios.name: dependency-audit
scenarios.description: User audits cargo dependencies — checks for outdated crates, reads changelogs, upgrades selectively

turns.speak: list all cargo dependencies that have newer versions available
focus on serde and serde_json, what are the current and latest versions
upgrade serde_json to the latest version and run the tests
if all tests passed, also upgrade tokio and tungstenite
